t: The Bristan Cinnamon mono mixer kitchen tap in polished chrome is ideal for new kitchen installations or renovation projects. This deck-mounted tap with single lever control features a long-armed swivel spout allowing easy movement and versatile use, accommodating various sink sizes and washing requirements. Its durable brass construction ensures longevity, while the 35mm ceramic cartridge delivers smooth operation. Equipped with EasyFit technology for straightforward installation. Suitable for both high and low pressure water systems, including gravity-fed setups.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
